**Status last verified against the record: 2026-08-13.**

That date is when a human last swept the handoffs, boards, ledgers and git log — *not* when
this page was rendered. A render clock would imply a freshness the data has not earned.

<Note>Every status here was swept from the real record on 2026-08-13 — board JSON under .claude/reports/, the enterprise-QA findings ledger, agent handoffs in .claude/state/, the docs themselves and git log — never from memory. Where a board carries its own item statuses, the checklist is DERIVED from those items rather than retyped. Where the record was ambiguous the row reads ❓ Needs review rather than a guess.</Note>

### How to read a status

| | Means |
|---|---|
| ✅ **Done** | Shipped **and** verified, with the receipt named in the Evidence column. |
| 🟡 **In progress** | Real work has landed; it is not finished. |
| ⬜ **Queued** | Agreed and specified, not started. |
| ⛔ **Blocked** | Cannot proceed — the blocker is named on the row. |
| ❓ **Needs review** | **Status genuinely unknown.** The record was ambiguous, so nobody claimed it either way. Never assume this one is done. |

`❓ Needs review` is the point of the whole system. An honest unknown is the reason a ✅ here
can be trusted — where the record did not prove it, we did not paint it green.

## Where this comes from

| | |
|---|---|
| **The catalog** | `tools/status/program-registry.json` — the ONE status record |
| **The generator** | `tools/status/render-status.mjs` — writes this page + the menu stamps |
| **To change a status** | edit the registry, run the generator, commit both |
| **To prove it is current** | `node tools/status/render-status.mjs --check` (exit 1 = drifted) |
